en: The postcard consists of two sides. One side features stylized color artwork depicting three women in early 20th-century attire, drinking from glasses with straws in a park or garden setting, likely part of a spa or mineral spring area. In the background, pavilions and a house among trees are visible. The reverse side includes handwritten cursive text in German, a printed heading 'Postkarte', several stamps and marks, and a prominent blue marking for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
